components.css: .ds-pass{display:flex;flex-direction:column;max-width:380px;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(11,31,58,.06)) drop-shadow(0 24px 28px rgba(11,31,58,.10));font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#0B1F3A} .ds-pass-top,.ds-pass-bot{position:relative;background:#fff;padding:28px 26px} .ds-pass-top{border-radius:28px 28px 0 0;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle at 0 100%,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) right/51% 100% no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle at 0 100%,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) right/51% 100% no-repeat} .ds-pass-bot{border-radius:0 0 28px 28px;-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) right/51% 100% no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle at 0 0,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) left/51% 100% no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 100% 0,#0000 13px,#000 13.5px) right/51% 100% no-repeat} .ds-pass-bot::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:22px;right:22px;top:0;border-top:2px dashed rgba(11,31,58,.18)} .ds-pass h3{margin:0 0 8px;font:800 1.7rem/1.1 Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.025em} .ds-pass b{font:800 3rem/1 Montserrat,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.04em}

narrative.overview:
The page is one dialogue between a farmer and a scientist. Questions arrive in white or sand bubbles, answers in green-washed bubbles, and the packages are seat passes with perforated notches. The ground is cream with a fine paper grain, cards are white and softly lifted, ink is a deep navy, and gold is reserved for the action and a flat sun disc.

The density is generous and phone first: wide section padding, single-column stacking below 960px, large tap targets. Real photography sits in rounded white-bordered frames. Navy appears as a surface only in the footer.

The page rejects the conference-brochure arrangement and invented proof: no made-up testimonials, statistics or logos.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground with grain; white cards; sand bands as rounded panels inset from the viewport edge.
Gold for actions and one decorative sun disc; green for answers, ticks and confirmation.
Pill buttons and chips, 20 to 28px cards, speech-bubble corner marking the speaker's side.
Stroke SVG icons only (1.75 stroke, round caps) on a shared 24px grid.
Motion is transform and opacity, short, and fully suppressed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Gold marks what to do (register, partner, progress). Green marks what is answered or confirmed. Never use green for a primary action other than WhatsApp, never gold for a confirmation.

rules.name: The Navy-Floor Rule
rules.body: Navy is a surface only in the footer (and tiny filled controls: step numbers, selected chips, burger when open). No navy hero, band or card.

rules.name: The Gold-Text Rule
rules.body: Gold text under about 1.2rem uses gold-deep; gold-lo is for large figures and icons; plain gold is a fill, with ink on top.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Montserrat for headings, numbers, buttons, nav and captions; Inter for reading text, bubbles, chips and form fields. Never a third family.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Countdown, stats, prices, times and package amounts use tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Rounded Panel Rule
rules.body: Bands are inset rounded panels, never full-bleed rectangles.

rules.name: The Sticky Companion Rule
rules.body: On wide screens the explaining column stays pinned beside the scrolling content.

rules.name: The Soft Navy Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with the ink color, long and low-opacity. Never pure black except the dark video frame, never a hard offset.

dos: Do frame content as question then answer; put farmer language first and the scientist's answer second.
Do use gold only for the action and green only for answers, ticks and confirmation.
Do keep cards white on cream or sand, 20 to 28px radius, with the soft navy shadows listed above.
Do use pill shapes for every button, chip and tag, and 52px minimum height for buttons (44px for any other control).
Do use inline stroke SVG icons at 1.75 stroke on the shared 24px grid.
Do put gold text on white only as gold-deep; use ink text on gold fills.
Do animate with transform and opacity, 0.25 to 0.8s with the ease (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), and gate every motion behind the reduced-motion rule.
Do keep copy honest: real programme, real speakers, real photographs; label unconfirmed items instead of inventing.
donts: Don't use navy as a hero, band or card background; navy is the footer surface only.
Don't reintroduce the brochure layout: logo row, speaker grid as hero, tabular price table.
Don't use hard offset shadows, pure black shadows (except the dark video frame) or colour gradients on surfaces.
Don't add a third typeface or system display faces for headings.
Don't use emoji or glyph icons; icons are the SVG sprite.
Don't invent testimonials, statistics, logos, or speaker photos.
Don't make bubbles symmetrical: the 6px corner always points to the speaker.
